maintenance_led.reason: Sells paint protection film, window tint and coatings, mostly applied to new vehicles or first-time purchases, not repair or replacement.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are vehicle owners, dealers and installers paying privately for paint protection film and window tint.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling more films through installer networks and new products; acquisitions of installers and distributors are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Installers and consumers can switch to other film brands like 3M or SunTek; protection film is not critical.

notes: XPEL's business is mainly products (film), with some services; the split between new and aftermarket vehicle installs is unclear.
